integrity: The all-parameter proof uses explicit Witt-to-Artin-Schreier reduction, ramification/differential calculations, and the Cartier identity. A standalone exact polynomial and GF(4) script corroborates rather than substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two, the specified genus-six cyclic-twelve family, and the marked branch point only. No full Ekedahl–Oort classification; historical priority and independent proof checking remain open.
title: Uniform Cartier nilpotency in the genus-six cyclic-twelve Witt family
